name: CHROM
description: Chromosome name used for coordinates and HGVSg (chr-prefixed).

name: POS
description: 1-based genomic position of the SV breakpoint (usually leftmost coordinate).

name: ID
description: Unique structural variant identifier for the row.

name: REF
description: Reference allele or anchor base (may be symbolic for SVs).

name: ALT
description: Alternate allele representation of the SV (symbolic or sequence, e.g. <DEL>, <INS>, inserted sequence).

name: VAR_TYPE
description: Specific SV class (e.g. DEL, INS, DUP, INV, BND or TRA).

name: VAR_LENGTH
description: Length of the structural variant in bp.

name: QUAL
description: Variant quality score summarising SV call confidence.

name: FILTER
description: VCF FILTER status for the SV call (PASS or filter labels).

name: GT_n
description: Sample genotype for the SV (e.g. 0/1, 1/1, phased forms 0|1).

name: GQ_n
description: Genotype quality for sample n (phred-scaled).

name: DP_n
description: Total read depth for sample n at the SV locus.

name: AD_n
description: Alternate-allele read depth for sample n (supporting reads for the SV).

name: VAF_n
description: Variant allele fraction for sample n (supporting reads / total reads).

name: GENE_SYMBOL
description: HGNC gene symbol for the annotated gene.

name: GENE_ID
description: Ensembl gene ID associated with the annotation

name: TRANSCRIPT
description: Transcript used for consequence annotation.

name: VEP_CONSEQUENCE
description: Functional consequence(s) from VEP.
value_range: VEP consequence term(s); multiple terms joined by &

name: HGVSc
description: Transcript-level HGVS annotation if derivable for the SV.

name: HGVSp
description: Protein-level HGVS annotation (if applicable).

name: HGVSg
description: Genomic HGVS representation of the structural variant.

name: CATEGORY
description: High-level category indicating this table contains structural variants (e.g. SV).

name: PRIORITY
description: User-defined numeric ranking used in PuzzleApp to visually flag variants. Values > 0 highlight the row in green (prioritised), while values ≤ 0 highlight the row in red (deprioritised or not prioritised).

name: PRIORITYFlag
description: Internal prioritisation flag indicating variant was prioritised by the user

name: INHERITANCE
description: Inheritance mode(s) recorded for the gene in PanelApp (e.g. monoallelic, biallelic). If the gene appears in multiple selected panels, all reported inheritance modes are listed.

name: PANEL_APP
description: PanelApp gene panels selected by the user that include the gene. If the gene appears in multiple panels, all are listed.

name: HPO_COUNT
description: Number of user-provided HPO terms that are associated with the gene.

name: HPO_ID
description: List of user-provided HPO terms that are associated with the gene.

name: clinvar_override
description: Flag indicating ClinVar evidence forces variant retention despite failing other filters

name: alt_allele_count_n
description: Number of ALT alleles present in sample n (e.g. 0, 1, 2 for diploid).

name: NOTES
description: Free-text annotation field for manual comments or curator notes within PuzzleApp.

name: PRIORITISED
description: Tiered prioritisation based on SVlog match strength (e.g. identical -> equivalent -> related). Higher tiers reflect stronger evidence of variant equivalence across datasets or logic rules.

name: KEEPING
description: Keeping tier (0-3) based on SVlog match strength (identical -> equivalent -> related)

name: KEEPING_EVIDENCE
description: SVlog predicates selected for explicitly keeping variants

name: FILTERING_OUT
description: Filtering out tier (1-3) based on SVlog match strength (identical -> equivalent -> related)

name: FILTERING_OUT_EVIDENCE
description: SVlog predicates selected for explicitly filtering out variants

name: SVLOG_ID
description: Identifier used within SVlog predicate space (may differ from VCF ID).

name: SVLOG_CONSEQUENCE
description: Consequence assigned by SVlog logic rules (logic-derived functional annotation).

name: ClinVar
description: Best-match ClinVar annotation string including accession, clinical significance, overlap metrics/coords.
value_range: ClinVar_id | ClinVar Classification | query_overlap / target_overlap | coords
note: for INS, ClinVar_id | ClinVar Classification | distance_between_insertions | delta_length | coords

name: ClinVar_CLASS
description: Simplified ClinVar clinical significance classification

name: gnomAD
description: Best-match gnomAD-SV record summary for this SV, including gnomAD-SV ID plus AF/het/hom and overlap metrics/coords.
value_range: gnomAD_id | gnomAD_AF | num_HET | num_HOM | query_overlap / target_overlap | coords
note: for INS, gnomAD_id | gnomAD_AF | num_HET | num_HOM | distance_between_insertions | delta_length | coords

name: gnomAD_AF_max
description: Maximum allele frequency observed for the matched gnomAD-SV record (used for rarity filtering).

name: InternalCohort
description: Best-match internal cohort record summary for this SV, including carrier counts (hom/het), number of families, and overlap metrics/coords.
value_range: num_HOM | num_HET | num_fams | query_overlap / target_overlap | coords
note: for INS, num_HOM | num_HET | num_fams | distance_between_insertions | delta_length | coords

name: Internal_families_max
description: Maximum number of families in the internal cohort carrying the SV (for the best match).

name: Internal_carriers_max
description: Maximum number of carriers observed in the internal cohort for the best match to this SV.

name: ONT1000G
description: Best-match ONT1000G record summary for this SV, including carrier counts and overlap metrics/coords.
note: for INS, num_HOM | num_HET | distance_between_insertions | delta_length | coords

name: ONT1000G_carriers_max
description: Maximum number of carriers observed in ONT1000G for the best match to this SV.

name: INTRON_GENE_ID
description: Ensembl gene ID for intronic annotation.

name: INTRON_TX_CHOICE
description: Transcript used for intronic annotation.

name: INTRON_ID
description: Identifier of the affected intron.

name: INTRON_STRAND
description: Gene strand for intronic annotation (+/−).

name: INTRON_START
description: Genomic coordinate of intron start.

name: INTRON_END
description: Genomic coordinate of intron end.

name: INTRON_LENGTH
description: Length of the intron (bp).

name: INTRON_DIST_5P
description: Distance from SV to 5′ splice site within the intron.

name: INTRON_DIST_3P
description: Distance from SV to 3′ splice site within the intron.

name: INTRON_MIN_DIST
description: Minimum distance to nearest splice boundary.

name: INTERGENIC_BOUNDARY_SPAN_TYPE
description: Classification of how the SV spans intergenic regulatory boundaries (intra or inter TAD boundary)

name: INTERGENIC_OVERLAPPING_ENHANCER_COUNT
description: Number of enhancers overlapping the SV.

name: INTERGENIC_OVERLAPPING_ENHANCERS
description: IDs or coordinates of overlapping enhancers.

name: INTERGENIC_NEAREST_UPSTREAM_ENH_COORD
description: Coordinates of nearest upstream enhancer.

name: INTERGENIC_NEAREST_UPSTREAM_ENH_DIST
description: Distance to nearest upstream enhancer (bp).

name: INTERGENIC_NEAREST_UPSTREAM_TAD_COORD
description: Coordinates of nearest upstream TAD boundary.

name: INTERGENIC_NEAREST_UPSTREAM_TAD_DIST
description: Distance to nearest upstream TAD boundary (bp).

name: INTERGENIC_NEAREST_UPSTREAM_TAD_SIZE
description: Size of upstream TAD (bp).

name: INTERGENIC_NEAREST_DOWNSTREAM_ENH_COORD
description: Coordinates of nearest downstream enhancer.

name: INTERGENIC_NEAREST_DOWNSTREAM_ENH_DIST
description: Distance to nearest downstream enhancer (bp).

name: INTERGENIC_NEAREST_DOWNSTREAM_TAD_COORD
description: Coordinates of nearest downstream TAD boundary.

name: INTERGENIC_NEAREST_DOWNSTREAM_TAD_DIST
description: Distance to nearest downstream TAD boundary (bp).

name: INTERGENIC_NEAREST_DOWNSTREAM_TAD_SIZE
description: Size of downstream TAD (bp).

name: FINAL_CLASSIFICATION
description: Final SVscanner classification indicating whether SV is non-repetitive, a tandem repeat or mobile element.
value_range: DNA, HOMO, LINE, LTR, Retroposon, SINE, STR, TR, VNTR, NON_REPETITIVE

name: CONSENSUS_REPEAT
description: Consensus sepeat sequence for tandem repeats.

name: RM_CLASSIFICATION
description: Repeat class(es) overlapping the SV: SINE, LINE, LTR, DNA, Retroposon, NON-REPETITIVE.
value_range: DNA, HOMO, LINE, LTR, Retroposon, SINE

name: RM_RECIPROCAL
description: Overlap class for the dominant RepeatMasker class. Full if at least ~75% of the SV is covered and each overlapped repeat element is mostly covered (≥75%). Partial if ≥75% SV coverage but some <75%.

name: RM_TOTAL_SV_COVERAGE
description: Proportion of the SV covered by RepeatMasker hits, with overlaps merged so regions aren’t counted twice [0-1].

name: TRF_CLASSIFICATION
description: TRF repeat class(es) overlapping the SV: HOMO (homopolymer), STR, VNTR, TR, or NON-REPETITIVE.

name: TRF_PERIOD_SIZE
description: Period size(s) in bp for each TRF hit.

name: TRF_COPY_NUMBER
description: Copy number(s) for each TRF hit.

name: TRF_SV_COVERAGE
description: For each TRF hit, fraction of SV length covered.

name: TRF_TOTAL_SV_COVERAGE
description: Proportion of the SV covered by TRF hits, with overlaps merged so regions aren’t counted twice [0-1].
